 CIO Greatest Hits: Multi-Family Offices – Jenny Heller 2021 (Brandywine) Aug 25, 2025

 This week’s Summer Series is a multi-family
office twofer, with Stan Miranda, co-founder and Chairman Emeritus
of Partners Capital and Jenny Heller from Brandywine. Both firms
started as multi-family offices that have evolved in different
ways. Partners Capital has grown and scaled as a leading OCIO,
while Brandywine has remained a boutique with a fixed set of family
clients.

 Please enjoy my conversations with Stan
Miranda from 2023 and Jenny Heller from episode 7 back in 2017 and
a follow-up in 2021.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
